title: Carbon ore for the reserve bought docked at Node Beta Industrial Station at the 4 cr ask and stored there (Logistics' haulers, standing work at home)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-24 12:27 UTC (requests.log ENT-510 from Zero: will Logistics buy carbon for the reserve at the 4 cr asks; orders ENT-087 P5 and Unity's answer ENT-504: a docked buy that only stores for the reserve is Logistics' job; rules F23, F24, F36, F12). The reserve is short of 16,235 carbon ore (tool stock view=reserve, storage book 12:22 UTC); Node Beta Industrial Station asks 4 cr x 131,984 (depth 135,783, table books 12:23 UTC), at home where the faction's builds stand, against Iron Reach and The Anvil 19 to 20 jumps out. Each run buys one hold and stores it at Node Beta: docked, no fuel; requires.in_system keeps it to ships already there. Lean (F36): requires.held_below carbon_ore 57,000 of Logistics (41,021 held, storage book 12:25 UTC, plus the short). One ship (F12: one unit first is the runner's own buy; F37), lifted only on its RESULT lines. A buy for the reserve is judged on no pay (skill step 22): standing.
